summary: The Dreamer is a short animated science-fiction film set in the year 2050. It follows an intelligent AI rover exploring the Moon and Mars, where it discovers abandoned NASA equipment and learns their stories and contributions to space exploration. Dreamer realizes that although these machines were left behind, their discoveries continue to inspire future generations of explorers.
details:
Our project The Dreamer, is a short animated film about an AI rover exploring the Moon and Mars in the year 2050. It meets old NASA machines and learns about their missions and discoveries.

After writing the story and the scenario, we used ChatGPT to design the characters, and Google Flow to animate the scenes.

We wanted to make learning about space exploration fun and interesting instead of just presenting facts. We gave each NASA machine its own personality while making sure the scientific information was accurate.

Our goal is to inspire young people to learn more about space and show that even when a mission ends, its achievements are never forgotten.
